It makes handcrafted furniture and décor from discarded tyres and PET bottles, sells upcycled products such as bags and side tables, and runs waste-to-wealth workshops, school sessions and community clean-ups. Its website reports more than 500 people trained. Zannytecture was one of nine NGN 1 million non-dilutive growth awards from the NiYA x Cascador Founders Programme, announced 10 November 2026. ## Zannytecture funding1 round The latest is a Grant announced 10 Nov 2026, led by Cascador. ### Who has invested in Zannytecture - [![Cascador](https://s3.amazonaws.com/startuplist.africa/investors/logos/cascador/cascador-logo.png)\\ \\ CascadorLead · Grant](https://www.startuplist.africa/investors/cascador) | Announced | Round | Lead · investors | Amount | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 10 Nov 2026 | [Zannytecture Grant](https://www.startuplist.africa/funding/zannytecture-grant-1m-ngn-87be0fd) 10 Nov 2026
